reviews.title: Much better than I expected
reviews.comment: I won't lie, this mouse really exceeded my expectations far more than the G Pro Superlight did. In the Era of the $150 mouse it's really hard to justify spending that kind of bread on something this insignificant, however I picked it up renewed and figured if all else I'd just return it if I didn't like it. I paid about $100 for this bad boy and it is really a treat let me tell you. In total I'd say that I've "collected" around 60 - 70 mice as of date and this one in particular is one of my top 5 favorites and I haven't really had a lot of time with this mouse. If you're trying to decide on whether or not this mouse is worth the asking price, I'd say that really depends on you personally if you're a hard-core gamer specifically fps or anything that's fast paced and require quick response times then yea I'd recommend it, but if you're casual and below I wouldn't you could get the regular one at literally half the cost but again that's all on you I'm very satisfied with it. The clicks are crisp and pristine, the shell feels really solid no flexing even when I tighten my grip around the mouse to make microadjustments, sensor tracks phenomenally, side buttons petrude just the right amount and provide tactile feedback when pressed. Overall it's really a gem if you can get your hands on one them.
